<!-- generated by scripts/generate-design-pack.ts from designer/src/assets/templates; do not edit, run `pnpm gen:design-pack` -->
# Golden examples

Complete, valid designs to copy structure from. Image `src` values in the examples are Zandovi-bundled paths; in your own designs use `zandovi://images/{id}` or a public `https://` URL.
